canonical_dedup: NFKC plus simplified Chinese; globally by canonical spelling, never by occurrence or topic duplicate
audio_reference_scope: Dataset supplied references, entity spans checked; not every utterance manually listened
negative_policy: No registered canonical surface in reference; split no-source-NER vs source-uncovered-NER where feasible
unknown_names_policy: Do not guess new spellings or aliases. Quarantine explicitly suspected errors without changing original data.
quarantine_recording_reason: 参考字符速率超过8字/秒，需独立抽听确认同步；未确认前不入主集，不判定为已错
alias_identity_caveat: Global uniqueness is by standardized canonical spelling; not a complete real-world entity linking/alias resolution benchmark
